en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European city nestled in a valley surrounded by high, rugged mountains with some snow on the peaks. The foreground shows dense historic buildings, church steeples, towers and a fortified-looking structure. Handwritten text and printed captions appear along the bottom margin, including the word 'Trento' in red and a photographer's credit.
